schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  ports: internal/application/ports
  use_cases: internal/application/usecase
  inbound: internal/transport/http
  outbound: [internal/infrastructure/persistence, internal/infrastructure/adapters]
  composition_root: cmd/ms-go-practice-runtime/main.go
invariants:
  - TaskInstance, Submission, and ValidationRun are separate durable aggregates/records; there is no V2 Attempt.
  - Catalog exact-revision envelope and verified digest are frozen into the TaskInstance before provisioning proceeds.
  - TaskInstance ID equals the canonical Start Idempotency-Key; replay with changed normalized input conflicts.
  - Submit intent is durable before Sandbox freeze; Submission and its first ValidationRun commit with TaskInstance VALIDATING.
  - A Submission always references one exact pinned snapshot; validation has no live-workspace fallback.
  - Validation PASS, FAIL, and ERROR retain distinct semantics; infrastructure errors never become learner failures.
  - Required mentor review and Sandbox permanent write-lock acknowledgement precede completion.
  - Completion and one final Student evidence outbox event are committed in one database transaction.
  - PostgreSQL state and receipts survive process restart; external delivery is retried idempotently.
  - Public projections never expose private evaluation context, test assets, secrets, raw validator output, or workspace file contents.
dependencies:
  catalog: exact immutable revision envelope and revision digest
  student: reserve/open/cancel LearningAction and apply completed evidence
  learning_planner: immutable learning-route receipt and materialization
  sandbox: stable workspace, durable pinned snapshots, monotonic write fences
  validation_orchestrator: typed official PASS/FAIL/ERROR result for exact snapshot
  teacher_agent: safe context, sanitized explanation, append-only assistance only
